about: Where every guard that verify-custom-mutants.js took away from the OLD page (79 mutants m01-m79, and the 3 equivalents e1-e3 that must survive) is now guarded, and what each of the 24 groups of verification/verify-custom.js covers. The mutants are exact-text edits of legacy/index.html, so they cannot be pointed at a bundle; verify-custom-mutants.js stays, for the old page. The rebuilt page's own mutants (exact-text edits of src/, each built in a scratch copy and run against verify-custom.js on the groups meant to catch it) are verification/mutants-new.json, run by verification/mutate-new.js; most of them carry the m-number of the old mutant they restate. A covering entry is "verify-custom g<N> check <text>" (a check of the suite, found by its text in group N; a text that ends where a name continues with a variable part, such as the module withheld, is the fixed part), "tests/<file> <test name>" (a Vitest test, named by its it() title), or "not applicable: <why>" (the mutant cannot exist in the rebuilt page; the entries beside it are what guards the behaviour). node verification/check-behaviours-custom.js checks that every reference resolves.
